title: echinopepon arachoideus
intro: Echinopepon arachoideus, commonly known as the "Coral Vine", is a flowering plant native to Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Echinopepon arachoideus include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in wound healing and pain management. The bioactive constituents of the Coral Vine include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
